newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says will meet 1996 public deficit target.
newsitem.headline: Spain says will meet 1996 public deficit target.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Wednesday Spain would meet its 1996 public deficit target, falling to 4.4 percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
"In 1996, the public deficit will come in as forecast," Rato told at an export conference.
The minister reiterated that the government would continue with structural reforms in the energy, land and telecommunications sectors in 1997.
In addition, the government will further pursue tax and savings reforms.
